observations: Wooden spear revision 02 retains only the original bare wooden shaft. The stone head and leather tip binding are removed above Y=0.90 m; the measured cut is closed. Source mesh and UV seams are welded before normal recalculation.
Revision 01 had backface gaps after recalculating normals on disconnected UV islands and is retained as rejected. Revision 02 removes those gaps in the exact export.

Obsidian spear revision 01 retains every original mesh/UV/texture byte and changes only the old knapped head to a dark, nonmetallic glossy material. Blade revision 01 exposes that same head primitive with its base at the origin.
The shaft measures 1.614 m; the complete obsidian spear measures 2.099 m. Attack timings and reach are deliberately shared gameplay values; wooden damage is 15 and obsidian damage is 30.
